question: Which of the following is associated with the retreating monsoon in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**October heat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **October heat** is a phenomenon associated with the retreating monsoon in India.

• It occurs during the transition period from the monsoon season to the winter season, typically in the month of October.

• The weather is characterized by high temperatures and high humidity due to the withdrawal of the monsoon.

• This period can be uncomfortable and is often accompanied by a lack of rainfall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Mahawat:**

• Mahawat refers to the winter rains caused by the western disturbances in the north-western part of India.

• It is not associated with the retreating monsoon but rather with the winter season.

• **Kal Baisakhi:**

• Kal Baisakhi is a local name for the pre-monsoon thunderstorms in the eastern part of India, particularly in West Bengal and Odisha.

• These occur in the months of April and May and are not related to the retreating monsoon.

• **Loo:**

• Loo is a hot, dry wind that blows in the northern plains of India during the summer season, particularly in the months of May and June.

• It is not associated with the retreating monsoon.

• **Retreating Monsoon:**

• The retreating monsoon refers to the withdrawal of the southwest monsoon from the Indian subcontinent.

• This process typically begins in the northwestern parts of India by early September and gradually progresses southwards.

• The retreating monsoon is characterized by clear skies and a decrease in humidity, although the weather can still be quite warm, leading to the phenomenon known as October heat.
